Read CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a pull request. Link the related Issue or design
discussion, keep this description current, and use Draft status for unfinished work.
Structure informed by Apache Spark's pull request template:

開 PR 前請先閱讀 CONTRIBUTING.zh-TW.md。連結相關的 Issue 或設計討論，隨時更新這份說明，
未完成的工作請用 Draft 狀態。PR 標題與內文請用英文撰寫；這些註解只是說明，不會顯示在 PR 上。

## Proposed changes

<!-- Describe the change and its scope. List every Issue this PR resolves with a closing
keyword, one per line (for example, Closes #123). Every change in the PR must belong to a
listed Issue, and each commit should name the Issue it addresses. Add the design discussion
or other context needed to review the implementation.

說明改動內容與範圍。用關閉關鍵字列出這個 PR 解決的每個 Issue，一行一個（例如 Closes #123）。
PR 中的每項改動都必須屬於列出的 Issue，每個 commit 也要寫出它處理的 Issue。
補上審查實作所需的設計討論或其他背景。 -->

## Motivation

<!-- Explain the problem, affected users, and why this approach addresses it.
For a bug fix, include a minimal reproduction or a before/after example.

說明問題、受影響的使用者，以及為什麼這個做法能解決問題。
修 bug 時，附上最小重現步驟或修改前後的對照。 -->

## User impact and compatibility

<!-- Describe observable behavior, API, SDK, widget, configuration, or data changes.
Call out breaking changes and migration steps. Include screenshots for UI changes.
If there is no user-facing impact, state that explicitly.

說明可觀察到的行為，以及 API、SDK、widget、設定或資料的變化。
標出不相容的變更與遷移步驟。介面有變化時附上截圖。
如果對使用者沒有影響，也請明確寫出來。 -->

## Testing

<!-- Describe regression coverage, commands run, and observed results. Include steps
for manual verification when relevant. Identify skipped or unrun checks and explain
why additional tests were not needed or could not be added.

說明回歸測試的涵蓋範圍、執行過的指令與觀察到的結果。需要時附上手動驗證步驟。
列出被略過或沒有執行的檢查，並說明為什麼不需要、或無法加入更多測試。 -->

## Generative AI disclosure

<!-- State whether generative AI assisted with this contribution. If used, include
"Generated-by: <tool name and version, if known>" and describe the checks performed
on its output. Otherwise, write "No". Contributors remain responsible for the change.
See https://www.apache.org/legal/generative-tooling.html for the referenced guidance.

說明這次貢獻是否使用生成式 AI 協助。有使用的話，寫上「Generated-by: <工具名稱與版本（若已知）>」，
並說明你如何檢查它的產出；沒有使用則寫「No」。貢獻者仍須為改動負責。 -->
